surfaces.label: Loopback HTTP Host, Origin, password, and response-header boundary
surfaces.notes: Central proxy enforcement and security response headers were reviewed and regression-tested.

surfaces.label: Electron renderer sandbox, navigation, popup, webview, and IPC boundary
surfaces.notes: The renderer is sandboxed; privileged IPC requires the main frame and exact application origin; external protocols are restricted to HTTP(S).

surfaces.label: Filesystem reads, writes, uploads, indexing, Git views, themes, and session references
surfaces.notes: Canonical realpath authorization now rejects existing and future paths traversing a symlink outside allowed roots.

surfaces.label: Provider credentials, OAuth callback tokens, and model configuration
surfaces.notes: Credential updates use locked atomic private-file replacement and OAuth callback tokens use cryptographic randomness.

surfaces.label: Plugin, skill, Git, export, and package child-process execution
surfaces.notes: Reviewed process launches use argument-vector APIs without shell interpolation; repository resources retain project-trust gating.

surfaces.label: Markdown, Mermaid, file preview, and theme content handling
surfaces.notes: Mermaid strict mode and upgraded patched rendering dependencies were verified; theme HTTP access now rejects path-shaped names and unauthorized cwd values.

surfaces.label: Production dependency vulnerability exposure
surfaces.notes: Next, Mermaid, Undici and vulnerable transitive packages were upgraded; npm audit --omit=dev reports zero vulnerabilities.
